visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Caller's Pointer Never Changes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: pick_larger should leave larger pointing at y and print 30, but the program prints 12.

solution.explanation: Passing larger by value gives the function its own copy of the pointer. Changing that copy does not affect the caller's pointer, which still points at x. To change a pointer you must pass its address (int **) and assign through it.
